recognize_zh: 整個視野中有相當比例的紅血球呈兩側平行、長軸明顯的橢圓形或雪茄狀（橢圓形紅血球，elliptocyte），其餘多為卵圓形，缺乏碎片或淚滴細胞，符合遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症。
features: Numerous elliptocytes with long axis clearly exceeding short axis, some cigar- or pencil-shaped with parallel sides
Many additional ovalocytes; remaining cells round with central pallor
Red cells approximately normocytic with preserved central pallor in most cells
No significant schistocytes, teardrop cells or spherocytes in this field
Scattered platelets; weakly stained (blue-gray cast) smear
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a prominent population of elliptocytes, including cigar-shaped forms with parallel sides, together with ovalocytes. Red cells are otherwise normocytic with preserved central pallor, and schistocytes, teardrop cells and spherocytes are not conspicuous. Platelets are present. The stain is weak, limiting color assessment. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows microcytic, hypochromic cells with variable pencil forms and low ferritin, rather than a uniform population of normochromic elliptocytes.
Myelofibrosis shows teardrop cells, leukoerythroblastosis and poikilocytosis rather than a predominance of regular elliptocytes.
SAO cells are rounder stomatocytic ovalocytes, often with one or two transverse bars or slits, due to a SLC4A1 deletion.
Macro-ovalocytes are larger (high MCV) and accompanied by hypersegmented neutrophils.
